note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `meta` has three disjoint shapes across the 2056 records: 1934 are thin `{factory, generator, round}`, 96 add `plant`, and 26 add `kind` / `mechanic` / `product`. The datasets-server infers `meta` from `batch-r01.jsonl` and then cannot cast the later shards (`Couldn't cast struct<factory, round, generator, plant> to {factory, round, generator}`), so the streaming preview works while `viewer`, `search`, `filter` and `statistics` stay false and no parquet index is built. Declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: plan
features.note: present on 2056 of 2056 records and never empty; mandatory in this dataset, unlike the sibling declaration where it is optional

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool across nine tools — `command` 23202, `path` 12958, `old` / `new` 6010 each, `pattern` 2124, `cmd` 336, `diff` 240, `glob` 96, `limit` 48, `contents` 42. No single key varies by value type, but `limit` is an integer while every other value is a string, so the union cannot be a struct of strings

list.name: reflection
list.note: present on 696 of 36640 steps; always a string where present

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success` (bool), `tests_passed` and `cost_steps` (int) on every record, plus `xfailed` on 999, `residual` on 24, `handoff` on 13, `plan_changes` on 2 and eight single-record extras. The extras are not one type: `acorn` is a string, `glibc` and `second_build_s` are floats, the rest are integers

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag in three disjoint shapes: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on all 2056; `plant` on 96 (`batch-r526`–`batch-r549` and `batch-r647`–`batch-r684`); `kind`, `mechanic`, `product` on 26 (`batch-r634`–`batch-r646`). No record carries both `plant` and `kind`

disclosures: Every one of the 2056 records is a `docker-build-cache-factory` episode generated by `grok-4.6` under a `dbc-` id. There is no leftover-mill mix and no dest-stamped foreign payload in this dataset: the factory, generator and id prefix were checked on every record, not sampled.

833 of the 2056 record ids contain `leftover` (for example `dbc-r1000-sp5100-tco-leftover-8744`). That is this factory's own advertised leftover-cache mechanic, not a foreign dump mixed in — a same-factory leftover-* id is not a mixed record.

disclosures.summary: 26 records in `batch-r634`–`batch-r646` are the hand-designed cache-product × leftover-invalidation templates (BuildKit cache mounts, nydus RAFS blobcache, eStargz TOC, overlayfs, GitHub Actions cache, Depot, Earthly, Dagger, Kaniko, Buildah, Podman, nerdctl, containerd). They are the only records carrying `meta.kind`, `meta.mechanic` and `meta.product`, their ids end `-l3`, and they are the second way the inferred schema dies. They are kept exactly as generated and are owned by this dataset.

The mill that produced those 26 records also stamps `dbc-*-l3` copies into other factories' dumps. Those outbound rows are foreign payload on the destination cards and are disclosed there, not here; every `-l3` row in this dataset is a home-dump record with `meta.factory: docker-build-cache-factory`.

`meta.plant` appears on 96 records in two disjoint runs, not one. 48 records in `batch-r526`–`batch-r549` carry a named plant (`zonefs-cnv-leftover`, `smlnj-heap-cache`, `btrfs-raid1c4-leftover`, …); the other 48, in `batch-r647`–`batch-r684`, carry the literal string `designed`. Those 48 are a different set from the 26 records whose `meta.kind` is `designed`, and the two markers never co-occur on one record.

Eight records each carry a single-record `reward` extra key, and those extras are not one type: `acorn` is the string `8.14.1`, `glibc` (2.41) and `second_build_s` (11.2) are floats, and `cache_prefix_restores`, `model_bytes`, `npm_ci_layer_bytes`, `context_bytes` and `gitleaks_findings` are integers. `reward` is declared `json` for that type spread as well as for its varying key set.

disclosures: Every step publishes a public `decision_basis` (36640 of 36640). There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
